mapper.select:
SELECT id, uploader, upload_time, department, process_name, process_purpose, status, attachment_path, attachment_name, reviewer, review_time, review_comment, created_at, updated_at FROM todo_items
AND process_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{processName}, '%')
AND uploader LIKE CONCAT('%', #{uploader}, '%')
AND department LIKE CONCAT('%', #{department}, '%')
AND status = #{status}
ORDER BY upload_time DESC
